hypotheses.claim: Contextual rank composition beats the best fixed policy on held-out aggregate performance.
hypotheses.success_criteria: Mean ANWG exceeds best fixed on ID_TEST and at least one OOD split with paired bootstrap confidence intervals not centered on zero.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Best fixed WSP or another fixed policy remains superior on meaningful held-out or OOD windows, or gains appear only on train/validation.

hypotheses.claim: Contextual rank composition beats discrete policy selection.
hypotheses.success_criteria: Composition improves ANWG and oracle-gap closure versus the frozen discrete selector without higher feasibility violations.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Discrete selection matches or beats composition on ID and OOD, or composition gains come from held-out tuned weights.

hypotheses.claim: Component-wise composition improves at least one important frontier region without materially degrading global robustness.
hypotheses.success_criteria: Component-wise composition reduces regret in a pre-registered frontier region and does not lose more than a small tolerance globally versus best fixed.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Region gains are offset by broad held-out degradation or rely on unsupported simulator semantics.

hypotheses.claim: Sparse top-k composition is at least as robust as dense composition.
hypotheses.success_criteria: Top-k composition matches or improves dense composition on OOD ANWG and has lower switching/entropy without higher regret.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Dense composition consistently outperforms sparse top-k on held-out meaningful windows.

hypotheses.claim: Composition gains persist on OOD workloads and are not caused by leakage.
hypotheses.success_criteria: Leakage audits pass and improvements persist on temporal, cross-source, and final untouched OOD splits.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Any split-group/raw-range leakage is detected, or improvements vanish on untouched OOD.

global_failure_rule: Composition is not successful if improvements are confined to training/validation or if a simple fixed WSP baseline remains superior on meaningful held-out/OOD evaluations.
